fusions.name: Drawn Thread
fusions.desc: Sends a strand into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Snared Mass
fusions.desc: Casts a web of strands around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. Each has a 60% chance of being [Slowed] for 6 seconds. You restore 14 health.

fusions.name: Stitch in Time
fusions.desc: Restores 22 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Thousand Straws
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
